description: Block an account, or unblock with `unblock: true`. Blocking cuts all contact and hides your profile from them. Rate-limited calls return `done: false`. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

user.description: Account: username, profile URL, or numeric id.

name: ig_block
title: Instagram block
